generations.name: Neue Klasse (NA0)
generations.notes: New Neue Klasse sedan, unrelated to the 2014-2021 i3 hatchback (EPA files it under the same base model "i3", so this model claims the "i3 50 xDrive" labels). Gen6 eDrive, 800 V, cylindrical cells; same 108.7 kWh net (Europe) pack and up to 400 kW DC as the iX3 50 xDrive; US launch Q1 2027. US pack size is reported near 112 kWh (unconfirmed by BMW USA). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://theevreport.com/bmw-i3-us-price-range-2027 ; https://www.aol.com/articles/2027-bmw-i3-neue-klasse-100000448.html
